purpose: Operational question-template configuration for the current agentic Question Studio pipeline.

enabled.useWhen: One option is best-supported by the source and distractors are plausible near-misses.

configReadyButDisabled.enableWhen: The candidate schema, coercion, review, and insert path allow correctAnswers.length > 1.
configReadyButDisabled.useWhen: Several options are independently true and the complete set matters.

unsupported.reason: Current candidate output and grading path are multiple-choice only.
Current candidate output has one flat options array, not prompt-answer pairs.
Current worker prompt does not guarantee media attachment, rendering, or media-dependent review.
Current candidate schema requires 3-5 options, so true/false is not a separate two-option format.

disabledByDefault.reason: Negative stems are high-risk for ambiguity and should be used only when the boundary itself is the learning objective.

adaptations.recognition.feature_set: Use only when multi-select is enabled; otherwise convert to a single-best feature question.
adaptations.interpretation.test: Use text, measurement, lab, field, or described exam data only; do not require hidden media.
adaptations.sequence.timeline: Use single-step order decisions such as which occurs first/next; do not use matching.

recall.definition: [Description] is best described by which term?
recall.threshold: Which value is the usual cutoff for [criterion]?
Which range is expected for [measurement] in [context]?
Which option best represents the threshold for [condition or decision]?
recognition.feature: Which finding is most associated with [condition]?
recognition.feature_set: Which option is the best defining feature of [category]?
Which statement best captures what [items] have in common?
Which feature most strongly belongs to [category]?
When multi-select is enabled: Which of the following are associated with [topic]?
discrimination.compare: Which feature makes [A] more likely than [B]?
Which test result would best distinguish [A] from [B]?
mechanism.causal: Which change best accounts for [observed result]?
diagnosis.case: A patient has [signal findings]. Which diagnosis is most likely?
Given [history/exam/test result], which condition best explains the presentation?
Which diagnosis best fits [key clue set]?
Which option is most consistent with [timeline plus decisive finding]?
interpretation.test: Which interpretation is most consistent with [measurement/result]?
What does [test result] most strongly suggest?
Given [data], which conclusion is best supported?
Which option best explains the pattern in [described finding]?
management.next_step: What is the most appropriate next step?
Which treatment is most appropriate given [constraint]?
Which management choice best fits [diagnosis/severity/risk factor]?
What should be done next after [finding/result]?
safety.contraindication: Which factor is a contraindication to [action]?
Which adverse effect should be monitored with [medication/intervention]?
Which option identifies the main harm to avoid in [scenario]?
sequence.timeline: Which step should occur first in [process]?
Which stage is most consistent with [timing/finding]?
Which option correctly places [event] in the sequence?
negative.exception: Which option is NOT expected in [condition]?
Which statement is the exception for [category]?
Which option is least consistent with [diagnosis/process]?
Which action would NOT be appropriate in [scenario]?

defaultMix.notes: Adjust by source. Do not force management, diagnosis, or mechanism when the source only supports recall.
